fact: The paper, published 26 September 2025, states that a new digital hospital information system named OpenClinic was introduced in Gaya and Gothèye district hospitals under the Belgian-funded PASS-Sutura project, and that this funding is set to end in 2026 with domestic and international financing still to be found.
title: Integrating specialised services into primary health care in Niger: from fragmentation to coordination
publisher: Journal of Global Health Economics and Policy
